svg.text: Review only: an inward bracket move loses side-member seating
Current106-bolt external-hex model remains unchanged. Both corners behave the same; left corner shown schematically.
A. Move the complete factory angle and hole pattern inward
Side timber
Top rail
Exterior head / washer and side timber stay fixed.
4mm empty gap
between wood and side flange
Minimum move1.5875mm: end distance66.675mm, zero nominal margin.
Review move4mm: end distance69.0875mm,2.4125mm beyond7D.
Both moves open an equal side gap; rail contact remains flush.
Moving the whole side bolt stack embeds its exterior washer in wood.
Both flush seats require ΔX = 0; improving the along-X end distance requires ΔX ≠ 0.
B. Extend the top end with the bracket fixed
Side timber
Top rail
The entire added end slab
overlaps existing side timber.
1.5875mm extension:19,715.686mm³ overlap per end.
4mm extension:49,677.320mm³ overlap per end.
No clear full-section extension exists at these fixed seats.
The65.0875mm factory row is the furthest one; the23.8125mm row is closer.
Concrete alternatives require a separate choice
A compatible factory fitting could retain both seated faces while placing its beam holes at least68.675mm from the heel
for the separate7D+2mm screen. Existing owned far holes remain65.0875mm; no replacement product is selected.
Alternatively retain the current layout and complete its applicable reduced-end / signed-action method; no factor is adopted here.
Schematic, not a drilling template.7D is the stated principal reference;2mm is a planning screen, not a universal code rule. No packer, stand-off, timber cut or release is authorized.
